findings.description: Fallback path calls run_treasury_agent then _require(result, 'winner_org_id', 'auction'). Treasury agent LLM output has no contract enforcing this key; a response that omits it raises ApplicationError with no recovery path. Add result.setdefault('winner_org_id', '') before the _require gate.

delta_threshold accepts percent values (e.g., 2.0) but is divided by 100 inside the activity. A caller passing 0.02 directly would set an effective threshold of 0.0002. Rename to delta_threshold_pct or add a docstring assertion clarifying the unit.

winner_org_id is overwritten on each loop iteration, returning only the marginal recycler's ID even when multiple recyclers contribute volume. Confirm single-winner semantics match the contractual requirement; extend to winner_org_ids list if not.

findings.item: E-way HITL gate bypassable when LLM drops status and requires_hitl
findings.description: If the logistics LLM response is missing both 'status' and 'requires_hitl' keys at the top level, both workflow HITL gates evaluate to false and HITL is skipped. Add elif not parsed.get('verified', True): parsed['requires_hitl'] = True to cover the missing-status case.
